item.title: Gang Green three-peat: Shenendehowa ice hockey topples Burnt Hills/Ballston for third-straight Section 2 Division 1 title
item.description: SCHENECTADY, N.Y. — Green and white have conquered Section 2 hockey in New York for the past few years. The Shenendehowa varsity ice hockey team has made four sectional final appearances in the last five seasons, winning it all in 2022 against Adirondack and slashing Saratoga Springs to take the sectional crown in 2024 and 2025. item.title: HIGH SCHOOL GIRLS BASKETBALL: McDonough Sports Complex becomes ‘Payton’s Place’ in Colonie’s OT victory against Shen
item.description: TROY, N.Y. — No. 2-seed Colonie Central High School rallied from a sluggish start and survived a frantic finish to edge No. 3-seed Shenendehowa High School 69-65 in overtime Monday night, securing its ticket to the next round and keeping its championship aspirations alive. Shenendehowa stormed out to a 14-2 lead after the first frame.
